Chapter 7019: As Heaven

Chapter 7019: As Heaven

Autumn Wind and the two brothers dared not refuse the command.

“Support us, everyone!” Golden Machine Immortal shouted.

Their allies have no choice but to obey, pouring their vitality into the withering domain. It improved dramatically and was no longer fit for living.

If it were to appear in a minor world, the world would melt like a snowflake falling upon boiling water. Living beings and the land would cease to exist in the blink of an eye.

“Hide behind me.” Heaven’s Equal shouted.

Till Ancestor couldn’t possibly endure the potent withering force, this applied to Amethyst Immortal as well.

“Higher than all.” Heaven’s Equal chanted and illuminated all of Dusk.

“Buzz.” His location became unreachable and higher than anything else, the high heaven included.

The withering force assumed the form of a ferocious dragon, attempting to break through the dimensions.

Dao fabrics and orders melted instantly. Even the force of karma was extinguished by this domain built by three golden immortals and a dozen grand immortals.

Heaven’s Equal remained undaunted and conjured a crystal ball of light within his palm - an accumulation of the pure light affinity.

The withering force enveloped him and froze his radiant aura, unable to melt it down entirely.

“There must be light.” Heaven’s Equal murmured as he crushed the ball of light in his hand.

The broken fragments exploded and flew in all directions. Each contained incredible light power and radiance, capable of banishing the darkness.

In this case, the withering force was a glacier meeting the eruption of countless suns. As the light took over, it pushed the withering force in the opposite direction. The sudden backlash caught the controllers off guard.

“Control it!” Autumn Wind shouted, not wanting to be assaulted by both the withering force and the light.

“Immortal Seal, As Heaven.” Immortal Bronze chanted, causing a seal to appear on its flat and smooth body.

It borrowed the essence of the high heaven for a smash. The immense weight caused Dusk to collapse at its center.
